answers.why: Every agent Build an agent makes is a package a host runs, with one program per job
It runs for one person in AgentMesh's tenant sandbox, which reaches only AgentMesh itself
A job that needs a model asks AgentMesh's model door at an address the sandbox sets; it needs no key and names no model, because AgentMesh chooses the model and pays for it

answers.answer: the account's daily model allowance on AgentMesh's model door, 0.50 USD a day, which AgentMesh pays

It answers the requests sent to it with nobody attending
